shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && ls -la && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts AGENTS.md; echo ----; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -60

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Toaster ToasterProvider ToasterComponent useToaster Button ThemeProvider 2>&1 | head -80; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; rg -n -i -C 2 'required setup|styles\.css|ThemeProvider' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -60

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toaster.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/constants.d.ts; echo ----; rg -n -i 'autoHiding|DEFAULT_TIMEOUT|TOAST_THEMES' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/constants.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toast/Toast.js | head; echo ----; rg -n 'Toaster' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts
